declaration.population_description: Synthetic design records supplied as the complete declared RDF-class population in each input. External legal/application eligibility and experimental edition selection are caller research assumptions, not inferred RDF facts or real-vessel certification. Records may be incomplete, inconsistent or contain unrecognized values. Conditions within the represented requirement, missing represented inputs, activation, datatype/unit/path and logical correctness remain for generated SHACL to assess. Evaluation covers finite represented inventories, not reconstruction of unrecorded real-world persons/components; this does not authorize inventing existence requirements or treating a represented missing value as compliant. General Table-8 material-selection records for represented plating/design cases. Authenticity of the supplied design/material references is a research assumption. The discretionary special single-strake allowance in Table-8 footnote 2 is outside this proposed research population; no conclusion is claimed for that exception. Selector/grade correctness is not assumed true, and all represented source conditions remain in scope.
